# PROCESS — cand_0005 (parent cand_0003, the current champion, val 0.593)

Method reconfirmed from LEDGER/JOURNAL: the adapter recalculates output with LibreOffice, so
standard formulas DO recalc and pass (11 formula-writers pass 3/3). Therefore "prefer literals
over formulas" is REFUTED (cand_0001) and any subagent claim that a task fails because it "wrote a
formula" is a red herring unless the formula is dynamic-array/spilling. The scorer compares each
answer cell by value AND Python type. All three edits below are ADDITIVE, conditionally-scoped, and
grounded in a specific failing trace.

Diagnosis was fan-out: 4 read-only subagents covering all 37 failing traces, then I read the 4
strongest candidate traces (254-34, 50755, 45300, 585-41) myself and cross-checked cand_0001's
winning code for 254-34 in the run_suite rollouts.

## Ranked cluster list (leverage = # failing tasks × recoverable score)
| rank | cluster | tasks | root cause | tag |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Overwrites the reference formula already sitting in the answer cells with a file-frozen literal | 50755 (B6:F6 held `=B2-B3`,`=D2-D4`,`=F1-F3` — heterogeneous per column — agent replaced them with a uniform "2nd-largest−3rd-largest" literal that matched TC1 only) | Agent read the exact per-cell reference formulas, then invented a paraphrased uniform rule and wrote literals → diverges on hidden files | STRUCTURE / narrowing of the existing "reuse the workbook method" rule |
| 2 | Find/highlight task → answer cell left BLANK | 254-34 ('Before'!C2 wants the subset-sum ≈994110; agent only colored cells, left C2=None) | Agent treats a "highlight the cells that sum to X" request as pure formatting; grader reads only VALUES, so the blank graded cell scores 0. cand_0001 wrote the sum to C2 → 3/3 | KNOWLEDGE / output-contract |
| 3 | Silent whitespace/normalization on string extraction | 45300 (`text[:idx].rstrip()` dropped the trailing space Excel LEFT keeps) | Agent trims surrounding spaces the expected value retains | CONTRACT / value fidelity |

## Deliberately NOT re-tried (prior RESULTS refuted these — never re-test)
- **"Prefer literals over formulas"** — REFUTED by cand_0001; formulas recalc via LibreOffice. So I
  DROPPED the subagents' "write literals not formulas" cluster (267-18, 50682, 53062). 50682 in fact
  fails on wrong COLUMN selection (cand_0004 fixed it by uniform scan), not on the formula.
- **Independent/adversarial VERIFY rewrite of task_template step 3** — cand_0002 shipped it and was
  REJECTED (broke 267-18 among others). The dominant meta-pattern (agent "verifies" by recomputing
  with its own logic) is real but this lever is refuted; not re-tried.
- **Global no-embellishment block** (leave #N/A, don't fill blanks, no .strip) — cand_0002 broke 4
  tasks with it. My EDIT 3 is the NARROW string-extraction slice only, not the global rule.
- **cand_0004's whole batch** (REJECTED, broke {2768, 31420, 347-49}): I did NOT re-add its
  workbook-reuse SOFTENING (its own PROCESS flagged it as the widest-blast likely culprit), its
  dynamic-array narrowing, or its "number-formats are NEVER graded" clause (it contradicts the
  MATCH-VALUE rule to carry number_format on dates). I re-introduce only the 254-34 idea (highlight→
  value) in a MINIMAL, contradiction-free form.

## Edits kept (all in prompt.md; each additive/conditional; verify + blast-radius)
| # | cluster | edit | verify-the-fix | blast radius |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 1 | WRITE-GENERAL-CODE workbook-reuse bullet: added "when the answer cells ALREADY contain formulas, they ARE the reference answer — don't overwrite with a file-frozen literal; keep the formula or write a corrected FORMULA; per-cell reference patterns may differ, reproduce each" | 50755 trace inspection shows B6:F6 = `=B2-B3`,`=C2-C3`,`=D2-D4`,`=E2-E3`,`=F1-F3`; agent overwrote with literals `[25,3,25,22,60]` from a uniform rule; those recalc-formulas generalize to hidden files, the literals don't. Edit routes the agent to keep them. | BOUNDED: applies only when answer cells already hold formulas. Passing formula-writers (2768,31420,…) write formulas into BLANK cells — no existing formula to preserve → unaffected. Formula→corrected-formula still allowed, so a "fix this formula" task is not forced to a literal. |
| 2 | 2 | New PRODUCE-THE-RESULT paragraph: for find/identify/highlight-by-numeric-condition tasks with a BLANK answer cell, write the NUMERIC RESULT (sum/count/located value) into it; coloring alone leaves it empty = 0 | 254-34: agent left 'Before'!C2 = None (printed "VERIFY … → None"); cand_0001 wrote the subset-sum int to C2 and scored 3/3 (verified in rollouts/val/254-34__cand_0001). | BOUNDED: trigger is (find/highlight-by-sum/count request) AND (answer cell blank in input). Does not fire for compute/lookup/delete tasks. Protected passers 2768/31420/347-49 are formula/lookup/row-delete tasks — not find-by-numeric-criterion — so behavior is unchanged. |
| 3 | 3 | MATCH-VALUE-AND-TYPE new bullet: on string extraction/truncation preserve surviving chars exactly — no `.strip()`/`.rstrip()`/`.lstrip()` or re-case unless instructed (LEFT/MID keep spaces); worked example "before 'FT'". | 45300 used `.rstrip()` and dropped the trailing space; expected (Excel LEFT) keeps it → 0/3. Edit removes the silent trim. | BOUNDED: applies only to string extraction/truncation and only forbids trimming when NOT instructed — a task that explicitly asks to trim still trims. Narrow slice of the (refuted) global no-embellishment rule; no passing task shown to depend on auto-trimming. |

## ENVIRONMENT / non-prose-fixable — flagged, NOT edited
- **34-5**: LibreOffice recalc renames sheet `SHEET1`→`SHEET1 -1` so the answer sheet is not found →
  0/3 despite correct values (documented by cand_0003). Infrastructure; a human must fix the recalc
  sheet-rename. No prompt edit applies.
- **146-49**: infra noise / hard string algorithm; untouched.

## Deliberately skipped (no safe general fix this iteration — mostly variance/task-specific)
- Interpretation-variance (ambiguous gold, no derivable general rule): 14207, 4225, 32975, 55912,
  55039, 577-40, 398-14 (subtraction sign), 50486/45944 (FALSE-vs-blank / casing already covered by
  the verbatim rule but ignored — known-but-broken, not a knowledge gap).
- Task-specific computation (unique logic, one-offs, no shared prose fix): 10281, 157-4, 250-20,
  269-44, 30930, 32023(offset), 32468, 39946, 413-15, 48983, 50526, 53062, 53305, 53449, 56561,
  58484, 58890, 6698, 49782.
- 585-41: numeric-vs-string type depends on whether the cleaned value keeps a comma (ambiguous);
  the existing MATCH-VALUE type rule already covers the numeric case — a further edit would be
  speculative, so skipped.

## Process & features used
- 4 parallel read-only diagnosis subagents over all 37 failing traces; I then read the 4 strongest
  candidate traces directly and cross-checked cand_0001's winning 254-34 code in the run_suite
  rollouts. Edits applied serially in this one candidate (no worktree merge needed). task_template.md
  left unchanged (all three fixes belong in the system prompt's contract/knowledge sections).
